assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape construction reference for a studio works register. Primary request: clean editorial photograph of installing wood-look 8 mm laminate planks over a thin foam underlay in a generic bright commercial studio. Low oblique camera angle: finished interlocking oak-look boards, one loose plank with a visible brown HDF edge, and a small exposed section of underlay beside the installation edge. Show a plausible installation scene, no people, no tools needed, no measurements, no branding, no text. Soft natural daylight, neutral walls, honest material texture. The image is an illustrative reference, not a photograph of an actual project.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape reference for a coffee lounge plywood furniture BOQ line. Primary request: a custom elongated café service table with a gentle curved plywood front, realistic timber veneer, one partially open end showing a credible layered plywood edge and framed plywood backing. Photograph in a quiet generic workshop or café fit-out. Show the plywood joinery as the subject; leave the granite worktop off so the furniture base and top support are visible. Clean ambient daylight, modest neutral colors, no people, no logos, no text, no dimensions, no construction claims. Illustrative reference, not a project photo or shop drawing.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape reference for a commercial Pilates studio fit-out BOQ. Primary request: an interior toughened clear glass partition between a locker area and a neutral exercise studio, with fixed floor-to-ceiling panels and one clearly sliding clear glass door on a visible slim upper track. Door is partly open, show a small discreet floor guide without close-up engineering detail. A faint glimpse of lockers and exercise equipment provides scale, while the glass partition and track stay the subject. Architectural documentary photography, soft natural daylight, realistic glass reflections and edges. No people, no labels, no logos, no measurements. Illustrative reference only; do not imply an actual installation.
